caseTitle.zh: 門診：走路像踩在棉花上

condition.zh: 營養性貧血 · B12 與鐵缺乏

tagline.zh: MCV 正常的貧血，和一個九年前切掉的胃
tagline.en: An anaemia with a normal MCV, and a stomach removed nine years ago

desc.zh: 不被一個正常的平均值騙過：推一張抹片、拿音叉、問出九年前的手術，再把血和神經分成兩條線追。
desc.en: Refuse to be fooled by a normal average: make a film, pick up a tuning fork, find the operation nine years ago, and follow the blood and the nerves as two separate lines.

desc.zh: 量生命徵象、評估跌倒風險、打第一針、在候診區注意誰臉色不對。門診的節奏，是你在帶。
desc.en: Take the vital signs, assess falls risk, give the first injection, and notice who in the waiting area looks wrong. You set the clinic's rhythm.

about.zh: 老派的血液科主治，白袍口袋裡永遠有一支音叉。口頭禪：「平均值是會說謊的。」
about.en: An old-school haematologist with a tuning fork always in his coat pocket. Catchphrase: 'Averages tell lies.'

about.zh: 門診護理師，認得候診區每一個常客的步態。抽屜裡有糖果，不是給小孩的，是給低血糖的大人。
about.en: Clinic nurse who knows every regular's gait in the waiting area. Keeps sweets in her drawer, not for children: for adults with low sugar.

role.en: New patient · anaemia and numb feet

about.zh: 72 歲退休公車司機。九年前因胃癌把胃整個切掉，之後一直很好。這半年腳底麻、晚上走路不穩、常忘東忘西。家醫科轉介：貧血，MCV 正常，原因不明。（虛擬個案）
about.en: Seventy-two, a retired bus driver. His whole stomach was removed for cancer nine years ago, and he has been well since. For six months: numb soles, unsteady walking at night, forgetfulness. GP referral: anaemia, normal MCV, cause unclear. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 隨身一本筆記本，記著張伯這半年同一個問題問了幾次。說話很直，心很軟。
about.en: Carries a notebook recording how many times this half-year he has asked the same question. Blunt in speech, soft at heart.

about.zh: 看處方會一起看病歷摘要。她打電話來，通常是因為發現了什麼。
about.en: Reads the clinical summary along with every prescription. When she phones, it is usually because she has spotted something.

about.zh: 半夜打給血液科值班，開口第一句常常是「血紅素這麼低，要不要輸血？」
about.en: Phones the haematology on-call at night, usually opening with 'the haemoglobin is this low; shall we transfuse?'

plain.zh: B12 是做紅血球和保護神經都需要的維生素。缺了會貧血，也會讓腳麻、走路不穩、記憶變差，神經的傷害拖久了不一定能完全恢復。
plain.en: B12 is needed both to make red cells and to keep nerves healthy. Lacking it causes anaemia, and also numb feet, unsteady walking and poor memory; nerve damage left too long may not fully recover.

plain.zh: 平均紅血球體積，紅血球的平均大小。缺鐵會讓紅血球變小、缺 B12 會變大；兩個一起缺，平均起來可能剛好「正常」。
plain.en: Mean cell volume: the average size of the red cells. Iron deficiency makes them small, B12 deficiency large; lacking both, the average can come out 'normal'.

plain.zh: 同時缺兩種造血原料，例如鐵和 B12。抽血的平均值互相抵銷，抹片上卻看得到大的、小的紅血球混在一起。
plain.en: Lacking two blood-making ingredients at once, such as iron and B12. The averages cancel out, but the film shows large and small red cells mixed together.

plain.zh: 細胞核分成太多瓣的白血球，是 B12 或葉酸缺乏時抹片上的典型線索。
plain.en: White cells whose nucleus has too many lobes: a classic film clue to B12 or folate deficiency.

plain.zh: 胃分泌的一種蛋白，像一把鑰匙，讓腸子吸收 B12。胃切掉了，鑰匙就沒了。
plain.en: A protein made by the stomach that acts like a key for the gut to absorb B12. Remove the stomach and the key is gone.

plain.zh: B12 缺乏傷到脊髓後側負責位置感和振動感的神經束，走路像踩棉花、閉眼站不穩。
plain.en: B12 deficiency damaging the back columns of the spinal cord that carry position and vibration sense: walking feels like treading on cotton wool, and standing with eyes closed is unsteady.

plain.zh: 用敲響的音叉放在腳趾骨頭上，問感覺得到嗎、什麼時候停。B12 缺乏常常最早失去的是這個。
plain.en: A struck tuning fork on the bone of the big toe: can you feel it, and when does it stop? Often the first thing B12 deficiency takes away.

plain.zh: 雙腳併攏站好，再閉上眼睛。睜眼穩、閉眼晃，表示身體靠眼睛代替失去的位置感。
plain.en: Stand with feet together, then close the eyes. Steady with eyes open but swaying with them closed means the eyes are standing in for lost position sense.

plain.zh: 另一種造血需要的維生素。B12 缺乏的人只補葉酸，血可能變好，神經卻繼續壞，所以一定要先確認 B12。
plain.en: Another vitamin needed for making blood. Give folate alone to someone B12-deficient and the blood may improve while the nerves keep failing, so B12 is always checked first.

plain.zh: 胃切除後，食物太快衝進小腸。吃甜的之後一段時間，血糖先衝高再掉太低，冒冷汗、手抖。少量多餐、少吃精緻糖可以預防。
plain.en: After gastric surgery food rushes too fast into the small bowel. Some while after a sugary snack the glucose spikes and then falls too low, with sweating and tremor. Small frequent meals with less refined sugar prevent it.

plain.zh: 閉著眼睛也知道手腳在哪裡的能力。失去它的人，在黑暗中最容易跌倒。
plain.en: Knowing where your limbs are with your eyes closed. Those who lose it fall most easily in the dark.

text.zh: 盧主治口袋裡那一支，柄已經被握得發亮。敲一下，放在大腳趾的骨頭上，問「什麼時候停」。比很多昂貴的檢查還早發現神經出問題。
text.en: The one in Dr Lu's pocket, its handle polished by years of grip. Strike it, set it on the bone of the big toe, ask 'tell me when it stops'. It finds nerve trouble before many expensive tests do.

text.zh: 一台顯微鏡、一盒玻片、染色架。血液科門診的老傳統：重要的抹片，醫師自己看一眼。
text.en: One microscope, a box of slides, a staining rack. An old haematology-clinic tradition: the important films, the doctor looks at personally.

text.zh: 放在護理站，旁邊就是阿惠的糖果抽屜。胃切除的病人在候診區冒冷汗，第一件事是測它。
text.en: Kept at the nurses' station beside Hui's sweet drawer. When a post-gastrectomy patient breaks into a cold sweat in the waiting area, this is checked first.

text.zh: 頸椎磁振造影推到這裡。脊髓後側那一條亮起來的線，是 B12 留下的字跡。
text.en: The cervical spine MRI lands here. The bright line along the back of the cord is B12's handwriting.

text.zh: 每一頁都有日期，記著「今天問了三次孫子幾點來」「晚上上廁所扶牆」。這本筆記，比任何量表都早寫下了神經的變化。
text.en: Every page dated: 'asked three times today when the grandchildren are coming', 'held the wall going to the toilet at night'. This notebook recorded the nerve changes before any scale did.

text.zh: MCV 是平均值。缺鐵的小紅血球和缺 B12 的大紅血球混在一起，平均起來可能落在正常範圍。所以 MCV 正常的貧血，要看紅血球大小分布寬度、看抹片、看症狀，必要時鐵、B12、葉酸一起查。
text.en: MCV is an average. Small iron-deficient cells mixed with large B12-deficient ones can average out within the normal range. So an anaemia with a normal MCV calls for the size-distribution width, the film and the symptoms, and when needed iron, B12 and folate checked together.

name.zh: 沒有胃，就沒有 B12 的入口
name.en: No stomach, no doorway for B12

text.zh: B12 需要胃分泌的內在因子才能在腸子被吸收。全胃切除後，身體的存貨可以撐好幾年才用完，所以症狀常在手術多年後才出現。補充要由醫師依吸收情況選擇途徑，神經有症狀時通常先用注射；胃切除也會讓鐵吸收變差，但貧血仍要排除出血。
text.en: B12 needs intrinsic factor from the stomach to be absorbed in the gut. After total gastrectomy the body's stores last for years, so symptoms often appear long after surgery. The doctor chooses the route of replacement according to absorption, usually starting with injections when nerves are affected; gastrectomy also impairs iron absorption, but bleeding must still be excluded.

text.zh: 補充之後，血會比較快變好，神經慢很多，有時不能完全恢復。所以追蹤要分開：血紅素和抹片一條線，振動覺、步態、記憶一條線。血好了不代表神經好了，也不代表可以自己停藥。
text.en: After replacement the blood recovers fairly quickly and the nerves much more slowly, sometimes incompletely. So follow-up is split: haemoglobin and film on one line, vibration sense, gait and memory on the other. Better blood does not mean better nerves, nor that treatment can stop.

note.zh: MCV 正常的貧血，不等於沒有線索
note.en: A normal-MCV anaemia still has clues

lines.zh: 家醫科轉來的：72 歲，貧血，MCV 正常，原因不明。附了一張抹片的報告：「紅血球大小不一」。你怎麼看？
lines.en: From the GP: 72, anaemic, normal MCV, cause unclear. A film report attached: 'red cells of varying size'. What do you make of it?

lines.zh: MCV 正常，但大小不一……有沒有可能大的小的混在一起，平均剛好正常？
lines.en: Normal MCV, but varying sizes... could large and small cells be mixed so the average just happens to look normal?

post.zh: 對。平均值是會說謊的。還有一行你沒念：「腳麻半年」。血液科的轉介單，最後一行常常最重要。
post.en: Right. Averages tell lies. And a line you skipped: 'numb feet for six months'. On haematology referrals the last line is often the most important.

guide.en: Call the next patient from the waiting area

lines.zh: 張伯走過來的時候腳步很寬、一直看地板，扶了兩次椅背。我先幫他做跌倒風險評估，旁邊放一張輪椅。
lines.en: Mr Chang walks over with a wide gait, eyes on the floor, grabbing chair backs twice. I'll do a falls-risk assessment first and keep a wheelchair close.

lines.zh: 他晚上去廁所都扶牆。我記在這裡，你看。
lines.en: He holds the wall going to the toilet at night. I wrote it down here, look.

note.zh: 振動覺消失，羅姆伯格陽性

lines.zh: 醫師，我開了三十年公車，腳最穩。現在腳底像踩在棉花上，晚上燈一關就不會走了。
lines.en: Doctor, I drove buses for thirty years; my feet were the steadiest. Now my soles feel like I'm walking on cotton wool, and once the lights are off I can't walk.

lines.zh: 張伯，您以前開過什麼刀嗎？平常吃東西的情形呢？
lines.en: Mr Chang, have you had any operations? And how is your eating these days?

lines.zh: 九年前胃癌，整個胃拿掉了。醫生說好了就好了，後來就沒有再追了。
lines.en: Stomach cancer nine years ago, the whole stomach out. They said he was cured, so nobody followed up after that.

lines.zh: 音叉敲響，放在大腳趾的骨頭上。然後請他雙腳併攏，閉上眼睛。
lines.en: Strike the fork, set it on the bone of the big toe. Then ask him to stand feet together and close his eyes.

lines.zh: 兩腳大拇趾的振動覺都感覺不到，到腳踝才有。睜眼站得穩，一閉眼就晃，羅姆伯格試驗陽性。
lines.en: No vibration sense at either big toe, only from the ankles up. Steady with eyes open, sways once they close: Romberg test positive.

lines.zh: 本體感覺不見了，他靠眼睛在走路。所以燈一關，就不會走了。
lines.en: His proprioception is gone; he walks with his eyes. That's why he can't walk once the light goes off.

guide.en: Make and read a film yourself

lines.zh: 門診檢驗角有玻片。重推一張，自己看一眼。報告寫「大小不一」，你去看它們到底有多不一樣。
lines.en: There are slides in the lab corner. Make a fresh film and look yourself. The report says 'varying size'; go and see how different they really are.

post.zh: 大的卵圓形紅血球和淡淡的小紅血球混在一起，兩群人。還有幾個多分葉嗜中性球，核分了很多瓣。
post.en: Large oval red cells and pale small ones mixed together: two populations. And several hypersegmented neutrophils, nuclei split into many lobes.

post.zh: 一張片子同時說了兩件事：缺鐵，也缺 B12。混合型缺乏。
post.en: One film saying two things at once: iron deficiency and B12 deficiency. A mixed deficiency.

note.zh: 沒有胃，B12 就沒有入口
note.en: No stomach, no doorway for B12

guide.zh: 跟師傅追查缺乏的機制
guide.en: Work out the mechanism with the mentor

lines.zh: B12 低、鐵也低。他吃得不少，為什麼會缺？為什麼是九年後才出現？
lines.en: Low B12, low iron. He eats well enough, so why the deficiency, and why only nine years later?

post.zh: 沒有胃就沒有內在因子，B12 進不去。身體的存貨撐了好幾年才用完。鐵的吸收也變差了。
post.en: No stomach means no intrinsic factor, so B12 can't get in. His stores lasted years before running out. Iron absorption is impaired too.

post.zh: 對。但鐵低，還是要問有沒有在流血。胃切除的人，吻合口潰瘍、大腸的問題，都要放在清單上。
post.en: Yes. But low iron still means asking about bleeding. After gastrectomy, an anastomotic ulcer or a bowel problem stays on the list.

lines.zh: 醫師，那就吃維他命嘛。藥局的綜合維他命，一天一顆可以嗎？還是葉酸？鄰居說葉酸補血。
lines.en: Doctor, then just take vitamins? A multivitamin from the pharmacy, one a day? Or folate? The neighbour says folate builds blood.

q.zh: 全胃切除、B12 缺乏且已有神經症狀，同時缺鐵。你怎麼開始？
q.en: Total gastrectomy, B12 deficiency with nerve symptoms, iron deficiency too. How do you start?

options.zh: 依醫囑以注射補 B12，鐵另外評估
options.en: B12 by injection per orders; assess iron separately

why.zh: 沒有內在因子，一般口服吸收不可靠；神經已經受影響，由醫師決定以注射開始最穩。鐵另外補，同時排除出血。葉酸要在 B12 補上之後才考慮。
why.en: Without intrinsic factor ordinary oral absorption is unreliable; with nerves already affected, starting by injection per the doctor's orders is the safe route. Iron is replaced separately while bleeding is excluded. Folate only after B12 is on board.

options.en: Folate first; cheap and builds blood

why.zh: B12 缺乏的人只補葉酸，血可能變好看，神經卻繼續壞下去，而且被數字遮住。
why.en: In B12 deficiency, folate alone can make the blood look better while the nerves keep deteriorating, hidden behind the numbers.

options.zh: 一般綜合維他命，一天一顆
options.en: An ordinary multivitamin, one a day

why.zh: 綜合維他命裡的 B12 少，又需要內在因子才吸收。對一個沒有胃、神經已經出問題的人，這是不夠的。
why.en: A multivitamin carries little B12, which still needs intrinsic factor to be absorbed. For someone with no stomach and failing nerves, it is not enough.

post.zh: 好，我記下來：B12 打針、鐵另外、葉酸先不要聽鄰居的。
post.en: Right, writing it down: B12 by injection, iron separately, and ignore the neighbour about folate for now.

note.en: A bright line at the back of the cord

guide.zh: 看神經科排的頸椎磁振

lines.zh: 他上個月在神經科照過頸椎磁振造影，報告還沒人跟他解釋。一起看。
lines.en: Neurology scanned his cervical spine last month, and nobody has explained the report to him yet. Let's look together.

question.zh: B12 缺乏、振動覺消失、羅姆伯格陽性的張伯，頸椎磁振造影可能看到什麼？為什麼還是需要照？
question.en: What might the cervical MRI show in Mr Chang, with B12 deficiency, absent vibration sense and a positive Romberg test? And why scan at all?

answer.zh: 可能看到脊髓後側柱的異常訊號，也就是亞急性脊髓合併退化，常在頸胸段。照的另一個原因，是排除壓迫性的脊髓病變，例如退化性頸椎壓迫，因為症狀可能很像，處理完全不同。影像正常也不能排除 B12 造成的神經傷害。
answer.en: Possibly abnormal signal in the posterior columns of the cord: subacute combined degeneration, often cervical or thoracic. The other reason to scan is to exclude compression of the cord, such as degenerative cervical myelopathy, which can look similar but is managed entirely differently. A normal scan does not exclude B12-related nerve damage.

post.zh: 後側柱一條亮線，沒有壓迫。報告寫的就是亞急性脊髓合併退化。
post.en: A bright line along the posterior columns, no compression. The report says subacute combined degeneration.

post.zh: 所以我不是老了，是缺東西？那補回來，會不會好？
post.en: So I'm not just old, I'm missing something? If it's put back, will I get better?

post.zh: 血會比較快好，神經比較慢，會好多少要看時間。所以今天就開始。
post.en: The blood will recover sooner, the nerves more slowly, and how far depends on time. That is why we start today.

lines.zh: 醫師，我老實說，我以為他開始失智了。同一個問題問三次，我還偷偷哭過。
lines.en: Doctor, honestly, I thought he was getting dementia. Asking the same question three times; I've cried about it in secret.

lines.zh: 張媽，維生素 B12 缺乏也會讓記憶變差、反應變慢。補回來之後，有些人會進步。
lines.en: Mrs Chang, vitamin B12 deficiency can also dull memory and slow thinking. Once it's replaced, some people improve.

lines.zh: 記憶的變化我們會一起追，需要時再請神經科看。您的筆記本，就是最好的紀錄。
lines.en: We'll follow the memory changes together and involve neurology if needed. Your notebook is the best record we have.

lines.zh: 那我繼續寫。這次寫他進步了幾次。
lines.en: Then I'll keep writing. This time I'll count the improvements.

name.en: A cold sweat in the waiting area

note.zh: 胃切除後的低血糖，不是打針的副作用
note.en: Post-gastrectomy hypoglycaemia, not an injection side effect

guide.en: Someone in the waiting area looks wrong

lines.zh: 張伯在等打針，中午吃了一個紅豆麵包配一杯甜豆漿。現在滿頭冷汗、手抖，說心臟跳很快。
lines.en: Mr Chang is waiting for his injection. For lunch he had a red-bean bun and a sweet soy milk. Now he's drenched in cold sweat, shaking, says his heart is racing.

lines.zh: 血糖機在護理站，糖果抽屜就在旁邊。
lines.en: The glucose meter is at the nurses' station, the sweet drawer right beside it.

options.zh: 測血糖，可吞嚥給快速糖，重測後再吃點東西
options.en: Check glucose; if he can swallow, fast sugar, recheck, then a proper snack

why.zh: 胃切除後吃甜的，糖衝太快、胰島素追太多，一段時間後血糖反而掉太低。先處理低血糖、重測，回升後吃一點有蛋白質的東西，坐著不要走。
why.en: After gastrectomy a sweet snack floods in, insulin overshoots, and some while later the glucose falls too low. Treat the hypo, recheck, then once it rises a small snack with protein; he stays seated.

options.en: Let him lie down and rest

why.zh: 沒有測血糖，就不知道為什麼冒冷汗。低血糖躺著不會自己好，可能變成叫不醒。
why.en: Without checking the glucose you do not know why he is sweating. Hypoglycaemia does not fix itself lying down; it can become unrousable.

options.zh: 是打針的副作用，今天不打了
options.en: It's the injection; skip it today

why.zh: 他還沒打。冒汗手抖發生在吃甜食之後，是傾倒症候群的晚期低血糖，跟 B12 無關。
why.en: He has not had it yet. Sweating and tremor after a sweet snack is the late hypoglycaemia of dumping syndrome, nothing to do with B12.

post.zh: ……好多了。原來是那個麵包。我一直以為是我老了心臟不好。
post.en: ...Much better. So it was that bun. I always thought it was my old heart.

post.zh: 胃切掉的人，甜的要少、要慢，少量多餐。我寫一張給張媽。
post.en: With no stomach: less sugar, eaten slowly, small meals often. I'll write it out for Mrs Chang.

lines.zh: 重測回來了，在範圍裡。時間、症狀、吃了什麼、給了什麼，我都記進病歷，醫師下午看得到。
lines.en: Recheck is back in range. Time, symptoms, what he ate, what I gave: all in the notes, where the doctor will see them this afternoon.

lines.zh: 衛教單寫三條：少量多餐、甜的配蛋白質慢慢吃、飯後一陣子冒汗手抖就先測血糖。
lines.en: Three lines on the leaflet: small meals often, sweet things eaten slowly with protein, and if sweaty and shaky a while after eating, check the glucose first.

lines.zh: 紅豆麵包呢？他每天都要一個。
lines.en: And the red-bean bun? He has one every day.

lines.zh: 可以吃，半個，配一杯無糖豆漿，坐著慢慢吃。
lines.en: He can: half of one, with unsweetened soy milk, eaten slowly sitting down.

note.zh: 藥師的電話，與正確的第一針
note.en: The pharmacist's call, and the right first dose

sub.zh: 張伯的 B12 注射處方確認
sub.en: Confirming Mr Chang's B12 injection order

lines.zh: 阿蒨。張伯全胃切除，B12 開注射，很合理。我把後續的注射時程印在衛教單上了。葉酸先沒開，也對。
lines.en: Chien. Total gastrectomy, B12 by injection: entirely sensible. I've printed the injection schedule on his leaflet. And no folate yet: also right.

sub.zh: 張伯的處方好像不太對
sub.en: Something looks off in Mr Chang's prescription

lines.zh: 阿蒨。張伯全胃切除、B12 低、腳麻，處方卻只有口服的維他命或葉酸。他沒有內在因子，這樣進不去，葉酸還可能把問題蓋住。
lines.en: Chien. Total gastrectomy, low B12, numb feet, but the prescription is only an oral vitamin or folate. Without intrinsic factor it won't get in, and folate may cover the problem up.

lines.zh: 謝謝阿蒨。改成依醫囑注射。好藥師就是這樣，在病人回家之前把我們接住。
lines.en: Thank you, Chien. Changing it to injection per orders. That's what a good pharmacist does: catches us before the patient goes home.

guide.en: Watch Hui give the first injection

lines.zh: 肌肉注射，每一步都有理由。順序對了，下一個人來打也一樣安全。
lines.en: An intramuscular injection: every step has a reason. Get the order right and it is just as safe whoever gives the next one.

q.en: Intramuscular injection: put the steps in order

steps.en: Apply pressure; needle into the sharps bin

post.zh: 就這樣？比我以前被乘客罵還不痛。
post.en: That's it? Hurts less than passengers shouting at me used to.

note.zh: 血和神經，兩條線分開追

guide.en: Plan the follow-up with the mentor

lines.zh: 一個月後，他的血紅素好多了，可是走路還是不穩。你要怎麼解釋、怎麼追？
lines.en: A month from now his haemoglobin is much better, but his walking is still unsteady. How do you explain that, and follow it?

post.zh: 血和神經是兩條恢復曲線：血紅素、抹片一條；振動覺、步態、記憶一條。血好了不能停藥，神經要慢慢等。
post.en: Blood and nerves are two recovery curves: haemoglobin and film on one; vibration, gait and memory on the other. Better blood doesn't mean stopping, and the nerves take time.

post.zh: 還有鐵的來源：內視鏡排了沒有？
post.en: And the iron source: is the endoscopy booked?

post.zh: 排了，下週。張媽說她會陪。
post.en: Booked for next week. Mrs Chang says she'll come with him.

lines.zh: 跌倒風險高，我幫他轉居家安全評估。還有一件小事：晚上走廊和廁所要有夜燈。
lines.en: High falls risk, so I've referred him for a home-safety assessment. And one small thing: nightlights in the hallway and bathroom.

lines.zh: 因為他靠眼睛代替本體感覺，燈一關，平衡就沒了。
lines.en: Because his eyes stand in for his proprioception: lights off, balance gone.

note.zh: 張伯在黑暗的廁所跌倒
note.en: Mr Chang fell in a dark bathroom

sub.zh: 下午那位張伯跌倒來急診，要輸血嗎？
sub.en: This afternoon's Mr Chang fell; transfuse?

lines.zh: 阿泰。張伯半夜去廁所沒開燈，跌倒，頭皮一個小傷口已經縫好，意識清楚。血紅素偏低，要不要輸血？
lines.en: Tai. Mr Chang went to the bathroom at night without the light and fell; a small scalp cut, already sutured, fully alert. Haemoglobin is low; shall we transfuse?

lines.zh: 他是慢性貧血，今天確診 B12 和鐵缺乏，已開始補充。血壓心跳穩、沒有胸悶喘，就不需要常規輸血，輸太快對心臟反而是負擔。
lines.en: It's a chronic anaemia; B12 and iron deficiency diagnosed today and replacement started. If pressure and pulse are stable with no chest pain or breathlessness, routine transfusion isn't needed, and running blood in fast can strain his heart.

lines.zh: 頭部外傷照你們的流程評估。他跌倒的原因是看不見就失去平衡，今天門診有寫。
lines.en: Assess the head injury per your protocol. He fell because without sight he loses his balance; it's in today's clinic note.

lines.zh: （電話旁）醫師，是我忘了開燈。明天我就去買夜燈，買公車造型的，他會喜歡。
lines.en: (Beside the phone) Doctor, I forgot to leave the light on. Tomorrow I'm buying nightlights, the bus-shaped ones. He'll like those.

lines.zh: （遠遠地）醫師，你下午說的那條線，我明天還要來打針，對吧？
lines.en: (From a distance) Doctor, that line you talked about this afternoon: I still come for my injection tomorrow, right?

lines.zh: 對，張伯。血那條線和神經那條線，我們一起慢慢走。
lines.en: Yes, Mr Chang. The blood line and the nerve line: we walk them together, slowly.

sub.zh: 平均值會說謊；血和神經是兩條線
sub.en: Averages lie; blood and nerves are two separate lines
